title: G7 (format): two algorithm boxes with Input/Output + correctness/termination/complexity proofs

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Location:** the two required algorithm boxes (direct symmetric; PCG).

Per the benchmark Algorithm Rule, each must use the `algorithm`/`algorithmic` (or `algorithm2e`) environment with: descriptive name, explicit **Input/Output**, numbered pseudocode steps (loops/conditionals via `\For`,`\While`,`\If`,`\Return`), followed by proofs of (a) correctness, (b) termination, (c) complexity in $n,r,q,d$. Prose-only descriptions are non-compliant. Add `\usepackage{algorithm}` and `\usepackage{algpseudocode}` to the preamble.
